data.name: Nom Nom: Cozy Forest Café
data.detailed_description:
Have you ever wanted to escape from the stress of urban life? Nom Nom: Cozy Forest Café is a cozy and relaxing decoration and rhythm game where you manage a café and befriend cute animals.

  • Low stress, non confrontational, relaxing experience.

  • 【Manage your own cafeteria】 Customize your place with furniture, decorations, lamps, wallpaper, and flooring. Take pictures of your favourite corners, dishes, and customers and share them on the café's website.

  • 【Adorable customers】 Forge friendships and learn about their favourite recipes and decorations.

  • 【Learn new recipes... To the beat!】 Prepare snacks and drinks, from waffles to sodas, to the rhythm of upbeat tunes and colourful animations.

  • 【Unleash your creativity!】 Practice your skills whenever you like. Experiment with new ingredient combinations and sell them in your own vending machine to earn rewards!

  • 【Use your own custom designs!】 You can customise different objects, as well as your dishes! Paint signs, posters and even T-shirts for your customers.

data.reviews:
“Nom Nom: Cozy Forest Cafe blends rhythm mechanics, creative freedom, and cafe management into a relaxed but engaging gameplay loop.”

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 version 21H1 (build 19043) or newer
  • Processor: x86, x64 architecture with SSE2 instruction set support, Arm64
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DX10, DX11, DX12 or Vulkan capable GPUs
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Monterey 12 and later
  • Processor: Apple Silicon, x64 architecture with SSE2
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Metal-capable Intel, AMD, or Apple Silicon GPU
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
